title: UI/UX Design & Prototyping Masterclass
description: Design interactive visual interfaces, build design systems in Figma, and master wireframing & UX research.
overview: Learn modern user experience (UX) research strategies and high-fidelity user interface (UI) visual design using industry standards.
learningOutcomes: Conduct user research, personas, and journey mapping
Create interactive Figma prototypes with smooth micro-animations
Establish atomic design tokens (Typography, Colors, Spacing grids)
Design accessible web and mobile application layouts

topics.title: Design Thinking Framework & Persona Creation
topics.summary: Understand the 5 stages of Design Thinking: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test.
cheatSheet: Base persona goals on empirical user research, not assumptions.
Use wireframes to test layout structure BEFORE adding visual color details.
Ensure minimum tap targets of 44x44px for mobile interfaces.
